name: apeiron-web
description: Drive the Apeiron Engine web editor (engine.apeironengine.com) from Claude Code: the same agent skills, recipes and agents as the apeiron plugin, with the hosted relay as its MCP server. Sign in once with /mcp and every browser tab signed into your Apeiron account is reachable. Includes the live editor band (selection-aware prompts, readable editor tool rows, one-key Undo turn).
